## Publication gate

The Death family passes only when:

- all eight stable IDs remain available to existing presets and content packs;
- every effect states a readable death trigger and creates a bounded tactical, investigative, terrain, or action-economy aftermath;
- bursts, zones, summons, clues, objects, and escape procedures are represented explicitly rather than hidden in prose;
- no random mass-hatch roll, vague Source Anchor clue, or condition duration confused with terrain lifetime remains;
- Spectral Dust and Death Cocoon compile as deliberate two-ability bundles;
- Brood Burst uses explicit CR-scaled hatch caps and only intact, unburned eggs;
- all CR projections compile with verified renderer parity.
